title: Congestion-pricing stakeholder map
goal: A policy team can decide whom to manage closely, keep satisfied, inform, or monitor.

rubric.must: Stakeholders are visibly positioned against power and interest axes.
High-power/high-interest stakeholders are visibly distinct from low-power/low-interest stakeholders.
Point sizes visibly encode relative stakeholder scale.
Quadrant dividers make engagement regions readable.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the matrix/quadrant exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The stakeholder map faithfully shows the six named groups against power and interest axes, with relative bubble sizes and readable quadrant guidance. No material overlap or cropping is visible.

items.evidence: All six stakeholders are positioned within the matrix, with interest increasing to the right and power increasing upward.
Mayor's office and Freight association are in the high-power/high-interest quadrant; Occasional visitors is in the low-power/low-interest quadrant.
All six stakeholder names and their scale values are readable.
Bubble areas visibly vary with the listed scale values: 6 is largest, 2 is smallest, and equal values have matching sizes.
Both quadrant divider lines are visible, and each region has a readable engagement label and guidance.
